title: Investing in Main Street Act of 2025
short_title: Investing in Main Street Act of 2025
committees: S-Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs Committee: Referred To 2025-02-25 || H-Small Business Committee: Referred To 2025-01-28
latest_action: Received in the Senate and Read twice and referred to the Committee on Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs.
summary: Investing in Main Street Act of 2025 This bill authorizes certain banking entities to invest up to 15% of their capital and surplus in one or more small business investment companies (SBICs) or in any entity established to invest solely in SBICs. The current limit is 5%.

journey.note: Passed the House; waiting on the Senate
